Become the messenger of Clerk Arlon to obtain Official Papers for Jatoro.

==Quest information==

===Requirements===
{{Standard prerequisites
 |campaign = Nightfall
}}
* [[A Message Home]] quest active

===Objectives===
* Deliver to Captain Gudur on the Plains of Jarin the proposed Sunspear duties needed during the visits of the diplomats from Kourna and Vabbi.
* Inform Elder Belin in the Zehlon Reach of the need for fresh game at the scheduled banquet.
* Speak with Stonecutter Ged on the Cliffs of Dohjok about meeting with the representative from the Wilderness of Bahdza.
* See Clerk Arlon for your reward.

===Reward===
* 500 [[Experience]]
* 50 [[Gold]]
* [[Official Papers]]

==Walkthrough==
Enter [[Plains of Jarin]] via the [[Sunspear Great Hall]] and speak with [[Captain Gudur]], who is directly east. To get to [[Elder Belin]], exit [[Jokanur Diggings]] into [[Zehlon Reach]] and head north to the village. For the next step exit [[Blacktide Den]] to [[Cliffs of Dohjok]] and speak with [[Stonecutter Ged]]. These are all simple talk-to-and-go-on steps with very little fighting required. Finally go back to Clerk Arlon and get your reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Clerk Arlon'''
:''"Let's see, there are several tasks you could do for me. This list of duties for the Sunspears to perform during the Kournan and Vabbian visit must go to '''Captain Gudur''' on the '''Plains of Jarin'''. For the large banquet planned at the end of the visit we'll need a lot of fresh game. '''Elder Belin''' in the '''Zehlon Reach''' must be informed so he can start the hunts. Also, a Vabbian from the Wilderness of Bahdza has requested to speak with some quarrymen on the '''Cliffs of Dohjok''' about their excavation tools. '''Ged''' can help you with that. Do these tasks for me and I'll have those papers ready when you're done."''
{{offer dialog
|accept = I need those papers as soon as possible. Whatever is necessary, I will do it.
|decline = Let me take care of some other things first and I'll get back to you when you're not so busy.
|ask = Don't forget, '''Captain Gudur''' gets the duties list, '''Elder Belin''' needs to prepare the hunt, and '''Stonecutter Ged''' will help you with the Vabbians. I should have Jotoro's official papers ready by the time you get back. }}

===Intermediate dialogue===
'''Captain Gudur'''
:''"Guarding diplomats is such a pain in the rear. They're pompous, rude, and careless. I'm sure these duties will be handed out as punishments and lessons to some unruly cadets."''
'''Elder Belin'''
:''"Such a banquet will require a great deal of game of the highest quality, but we are always happy to hunt with a purpose."''
'''Stonecutter Ged'''
:''"So there are actually Vabbians who are interested in doing more than lying about in luxury and counting their money? I'm intrigued by this Vabbian who doesn't shrink away from physical labor. Send him our way and we'll give him an audience."''

===Reward dialogue===
'''Clerk Arlon'''
:''"Ah, excellent timing. I just got back the approvals for Jatoro's status as an ambassador. Here are his official papers. And, since you worked so hard to get these here's a little something for you as well."''
